# Archive Fixtures

- `sample.7z` is `two_files_with_content_lzma.7z` from `sevenz-rust` 0.6.1,
  licensed under Apache-2.0.
- `sample.rar` is `version.rar` from `unrar` 0.5.8, licensed under MIT OR Apache-2.0.

These small read-only fixtures verify extraction because the launcher intentionally has no 7z or
RAR archive creation support.
